templates.name: Sangfor NGAF by SNMP
templates.description: Sangfor NGAF monitoring via private SANGFOR-MIB (enterprises 1.3.6.1.4.1.35047). Requires SNMP v2c or later; community/v3 credentials are configured on the host SNMP interface (8.0 items have no community field). Verified against a live NGAF running AF8.0.108.657 (nsf-1050a-i): sfIfInRate/sfIfOutRate are instantaneous byte/s gauges (x8 only, no Change per second); sfIfInPkts/sfIfOutPkts/drops are cumulative counters (Change per second); memory ints are kB; disk ints are MB; sfSysDiskUsage (.52.1) is not implemented on AF 8.0 and is NOT polled; fan/PSU/temp tables may be empty on some models.

triggers.expression: change(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.software.version)<>0 and length(last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.software.version))>0
triggers.name: Sangfor: Software version changed on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Firmware/software version string changed. Confirm the upgrade was planned; acknowledge to close.

items.name: Sangfor: Serial number
items.description: sfSnGW - serial number of the appliance. Not implemented on AF8.0.108 (nsf-1050a-i): item ships DISABLED to avoid unsupported-noise; enable it if your model exposes sfSnGW.

triggers.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.device.status)=0
triggers.name: Sangfor: Device reports WARNING status on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: sfDeviceStatus returned Warning(0). Check the NGAF system status page for the underlying fault.

triggers.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.cpu.util.1m)>{$SANGFOR.CPU.MAX}
triggers.name: Sangfor: High CPU utilization over {$SANGFOR.CPU.MAX}% on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: 1-min CPU utilization above {$SANGFOR.CPU.MAX}%. Check traffic/policy load; recovers below 90% of the threshold.

items.name: Sangfor: Memory usage
items.description: sfSysMemoryUsage - device-reported usage % (string, matches vendor UI; free/total ints would over-count cache/buffer).

parameters: var n = value.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');if (n === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(n))) { throw 'non-numeric: ' + value; } return n;

triggers.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.mem.util)>{$SANGFOR.MEM.MAX}
triggers.name: Sangfor: High memory usage over {$SANGFOR.MEM.MAX}% on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Device-reported memory usage above {$SANGFOR.MEM.MAX}%. Check session table growth; recovers below 90% of threshold.

items.name: Sangfor: Swap total
items.description: sfMemTotalSwap. Units as reported by device.

items.name: Sangfor: Swap available
items.description: sfMemAvailSwap. Units as reported by device.

items.name: Sangfor: Inbound throughput
items.description: sfSysInThroughput - instantaneous kbps (confirmed by operator 2026-11-16); multiplied by 1000 for bps display.

items.name: Sangfor: Outbound throughput
items.description: sfSysOutThroughput - instantaneous kbps (confirmed by operator 2026-11-16); multiplied by 1000 for bps display.

triggers.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.ha.ctrllink)=2
triggers.name: Sangfor: HA control link ABNORMAL on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: HA control link reports abnormal(2). Verify the HA heartbeat cabling/peer before a failover is attempted.

triggers.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.ha.datalink)=2
triggers.name: Sangfor: HA data link ABNORMAL on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: HA data/sync link reports abnormal(2). Session state may not sync to the peer; check the sync interface.

items.name: Sangfor: HA sync state
items.description: sfHASyncState: 0 - invalid, 1 - sync running, 2 - sync end, 3 - unknown.

items.name: SNMP trap: Interface link fail/normal (event log)
items.description: Catches sfFirewallTrapIfFail (.35047.200.200.5) and sfFirewallTrapIfNormal (.200.200.4). Event-log item: no trigger - per-interface link alerting uses ifOperStatus polling.

items.name: SNMP trap: Link down/up (event log)
items.description: Catches sfLinkDownTrap (.35047.110.24) and sfLinkUpTrap (.110.23). Event-log item: no trigger - per-interface link alerting uses ifOperStatus polling.

items.name: ICMP ping
items.description: ICMP availability check (Simple check; ported from the generic SNMP template). See the paired trigger for the up/down logic.

triggers.expression: max(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmpping,#3)=0
triggers.name: Device unavailable by ICMP ping on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: Three consecutive ICMP checks failed. Device or path down; other metric triggers depend on this.

items.name: ICMP loss
items.description: Packet loss (%) per ICMP check (fping defaults; tune via the FpingLocation system setup, not per-item macros). Ported from generic SNMP template.

triggers.expression: min(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)>{$ICMP_LOSS_WARN} and min(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)<100
triggers.name: High ICMP ping loss on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: 5-min ICMP loss above {$ICMP_LOSS_WARN}% (but <100%). Path degradation/congestion, not a full outage.

dependencies.name: Device unavailable by ICMP ping on {HOST.NAME}

items.name: ICMP response time
items.description: Average ICMP response time in seconds (ported).

triggers.expression: avg(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingsec,5m)>{$ICMP_RESPONSE_TIME_WARN}
triggers.name: High ICMP ping response time on {HOST.NAME}
triggers.description: 5-min average ICMP RTT above {$ICMP_RESPONSE_TIME_WARN}s. Latency/congestion on the path.

dependencies.name: High ICMP ping loss on {HOST.NAME}
dependencies.expression: min(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)>{$ICMP_LOSS_WARN} and min(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/icmppingloss,5m)<100

dependencies.name: Device unavailable by ICMP ping on {HOST.NAME}

triggers.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.name,#1)<>last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.name,#2) and length(last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/system.name))>0

items.name: System object ID

items.name: Uptime (hardware)

items.name: SNMP trap: catch-all (unmatched)
items.description: Catches any SNMP trap not matched by a named snmptrap[] item. Ported from Network Generic Device by SNMP; this template is standalone, do NOT link it together with that template (duplicate fallback key).

item_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Inbound traffic
item_prototypes.description: sfIfInRate - instantaneous byte/s (verified on AF8.0.108), x8 to bit/s.

item_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Outbound traffic
item_prototypes.description: sfIfOutRate - instantaneous byte/s (verified on AF8.0.108), x8 to bit/s.

item_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Operational status
item_prototypes.description: IF-MIB::ifOperStatus - authoritative per-interface link state (verified exposed on AF8.0.108; indexes match sfIfTable).

item_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: Admin status
item_prototypes.description: IF-MIB::ifAdminStatus - used to suppress link-down alerts on administratively disabled ports.

trigger_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: high inbound discard rate on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Inbound discards/s above {$SANGFOR.IF_DROP.MAX}. Check congestion/MTU/attacks on this interface.

trigger_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: high outbound discard rate on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Outbound discards/s above {$SANGFOR.IF_DROP.MAX}. Check egress congestion or shaping on this interface.

trigger_prototypes.expression: last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.if.operstatus[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1 and last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.if.adminstatus[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1 and {$SANGFOR.IF.LINK.ALERT:"{#SNMPVALUE}"}=0
trigger_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: in use but link alerting not enabled on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: This port is up (in use) but has no link-down alerting. Run scripts/configure_link_alerts.py --apply or set {$SANGFOR.IF.LINK.ALERT:"<ifname>"}=1. Auto-recovers once coverage is enabled (re-evaluation may take up to the 1h dedup heartbeat).

trigger_prototypes.expression: min(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.if.operstatus[{#SNMPINDEX}],#2)=2 and last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.if.adminstatus[{#SNMPINDEX}])=1 and {$SANGFOR.IF.LINK.ALERT:"{#SNMPVALUE}"}=1
trigger_prototypes.name: Interface {#SNMPVALUE}: link down on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Opt-in port reported oper-down for two consecutive polls while admin-up. Verify cabling/peer; recovers when up.

overrides.name: No coverage notice for virtual interfaces

parameters: var n = value.replace(/[^0-9.]/g, '');if (n === '' || isNaN(parseFloat(n))) { throw 'non-numeric: ' + value; } return n;

trigger_prototypes.name: Disk {#SNMPVALUE}: space usage over {$SANGFOR.DISK.MAX}% on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Filesystem usage above {$SANGFOR.DISK.MAX}%. Free or extend space (logs/pcap); recovers below 90% of threshold.

trigger_prototypes.name: Disk {#SNMPVALUE}: high temperature ({ITEM.LASTVALUE1}) on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Disk temperature above {$SANGFOR.DISK_TEMP.MAX}C. Check chassis cooling; recovers 5C below threshold.

trigger_prototypes.name: CPU core {#SNMPVALUE}: utilization over {$SANGFOR.CPU_CORE.MAX}% on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Per-core utilization above {$SANGFOR.CPU_CORE.MAX}%. A single hot core can bottleneck forwarding; recovers below 90%.

discovery_rules.name: Fan discovery
discovery_rules.description: Fans from SANGFOR-MIB::sfSysFanTable. Some NGAF models do not expose this table (verified empty on AF8.0.108 nsf-1050a-i).

trigger_prototypes.name: Sangfor: Fan {#SNMPVALUE} ABNORMAL on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: Fan reports abnormal(0). Hardware fault - arrange replacement before thermal shutdown.

discovery_rules.name: Power supply discovery
discovery_rules.description: PSUs from SANGFOR-MIB::sfSysPowerTable. Some NGAF models do not expose this table (verified empty on AF8.0.108 nsf-1050a-i).

trigger_prototypes.name: Sangfor: Power supply {#SNMPVALUE} ABNORMAL on {HOST.NAME}
trigger_prototypes.description: PSU reports abnormal(0). Hardware fault - check feed/replace unit; redundancy may be lost.

discovery_rules.name: Temperature sensor discovery
discovery_rules.description: Temperature sensors from SANGFOR-MIB::sfTempSensorTable. Some NGAF models do not expose this table (verified empty on AF8.0.108 nsf-1050a-i).

macros.description: Auto-recovery window for unpaired trap problems: the problem clears this long after the LAST matching trap (Sangfor repeats active alerts).
Update interval for system info items (ported from generic template).
Uptime poll interval (restart detection needs ~1m resolution).
Interface discovery filter: names matching this regex are discovered.
Virtual-interface name regex. The LLD override uses it to suppress the coverage-notice trigger on tunnels; configure_link_alerts.py reads the same macro so the two never drift.
Interface discovery filter: names matching this regex are excluded (default ^$ excludes nothing). E.g. ^(veth|ssltun|vpntun) to drop tunnel interfaces.
Packet loss (%) that triggers a warning.

Per-interface link-down alerting is OPT-IN: set this macro to 1 with the interface name as context on critical ports, e.g. {$SANGFOR.IF.LINK.ALERT:"eth1"} = 1. Default 0 because unused but admin-enabled ports would otherwise alert.
How long SNMP polling must be down before 'No SNMP data collection' fires (ported from the generic template).
Average response time (s) that triggers a warning.
